sql: SELECT m.match_id, m.start_time, m.duration, m.radiant_win, m.radiant_gold_adv, ARRAY(SELECT concat_ws(':', o->>'time', CASE WHEN o->>'type' = 'CHAT_MESSAGE_ROSHAN_KILL' THEN 'roshan:' || (o->>'team') WHEN o->>'type' = 'CHAT_MESSAGE_MINIBOSS_KILL' THEN 'tormentor:' || (o->>'team') WHEN o->>'key' LIKE '%tower%' THEN 'tower:' || CASE WHEN o->>'key' LIKE '%goodguys%' THEN '3' ELSE '2' END WHEN o->>'key' LIKE '%rax%' THEN 'barracks:' || CASE WHEN o->>'key' LIKE '%goodguys%' THEN '3' ELSE '2' END END) FROM unnest(m.objectives) o WHERE o->>'type' IN ('CHAT_MESSAGE_ROSHAN_KILL', 'CHAT_MESSAGE_MINIBOSS_KILL') OR (o->>'type' = 'building_kill' AND (o->>'key' LIKE '%tower%' OR o->>'key' LIKE '%rax%'))) AS events FROM matches m WHERE m.match_id IN (SELECT m.match_id FROM matches m JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE mp.patch = '7.41' AND m.radiant_gold_adv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.match_id DESC LIMIT 150)
